documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Nine Months Ended On 30Th September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ELANTAS Beck India Limited reported a 13.27% growth in revenue from operations, reaching ₹84,780.93 lakhs for the year ended 31st December, 2025. Profit before tax stood at ₹19,853.66 lakhs, reflecting an increase compared to the previous year. The company is setting up a new manufacturing facility in Gujarat and successfully integrated Von Roll's resin and tapes product operations. Management highlighted resilience against supply chain volatility, ongoing focus on safety and sustainability, and recommended a dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share. ELANTAS Beck India Limited reported a 10.09% increase in revenue from operations to 74,851.31 Lakhs for the financial year ended December 31, 2024, alongside a 10.74% increase in sales quantity compared to the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the markets served by the company continue to show strong long-term potential.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, the markets served by ELANTAS continue to show strong long-term potential.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the overall industry indicated a slightly subdued demand in the second half of the year compared to the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: The overall industry indicated a slightly subdued demand in the second half of the year, compared the first half.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Your Company is in the process of setting up a new manufacturing facility at Taluka Vagra, District Bharuch, Gujarat, and is currently in the process of obtaining the requisite governmental approvals.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended 31st December, 2025 aggregated to ₹3,087.84 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure incurred during the year ended 31st December, 2025 aggregated to ₹ 3,087.84 Lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: Margins improved by nearly 19 percent as compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 13.27 percent during the year, while margins improved by nearly 19 percent as compared to the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: The company faced unforeseen and unprecedented cost increases in specific raw materials during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Your Company also faced unforeseen, unprecedented cost increases in specific raw materials that could have also impacted availability, and subsequently business sustainability.

orders_capacity.claim: First Time Pass Rate reached 99.9 percent during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: First Time Pass Rate reached 99.9 percent during the year, reflecting stable execution across plants.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share for the year ended 31st December, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend of ₹ 7.50/- per equity share of ₹ 10/- each, subject to the deduction of tax as applicable, for the year ended 31st December, 2025 (previous year ₹ 7.50/- per equity share).

capital_allocation.claim: Funding for the land purchase in Bharuch has been sourced from the company's internal accruals.
